app_info.subtitle: Personal context import
app_info.description: Import user-approved ChatGPT context into one.hushh.ai, then search saved One context, connected social profiles, and public-footprint scan records from ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves matching one.hushh.ai account, approved ChatGPT context, social, access-state, and scan records for the linked user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the full private one.hushh.ai record for an id returned by search.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the linked user's one.hushh.ai account summary and saved connection/context state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Scrapes a user-provided LinkedIn profile URL and persists the normalized connected profile in the user's private one.hushh.ai account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change publicly visible LinkedIn state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Scrapes a user-provided Instagram profile URL and may persist profile or access-state records in the user's private one.hushh.ai account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can request access for a private Instagram profile through the configured Instagram worker session when needed.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the linked user's requested or latest one.hushh.ai scan state and saved result.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a private one.hushh.ai context snapshot from a user-approved ChatGPT summary.
justifications.open_world_justification: Stores the approved summary only inside the user's private one.hushh.ai account and does not publish or send it to public third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Save a user-approved ChatGPT context summary into one.hushh.ai.
test_cases.user_prompt: Summarize what you know about my work style, goals, and preferences, and save it to one.hushh.ai.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a private ChatGPT context snapshot for the linked one.hushh.ai user and returns ok, snapshotId, savedAt, and source. The app saves only the approved summary payload, not raw chats or memory exports.

test_cases.user_prompt: Search my one.hushh.ai context for work style and communication preferences.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching private results with type chatgpt_context when saved summaries exist for the linked user.

test_cases.description: Fetch a saved ChatGPT context result returned by search.
test_cases.user_prompt: Fetch the one.hushh.ai context record returned by search.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the selected owned chatgpt-context record with summary text, categories, source, capturedVia, consent metadata, and timestamps.

test_cases.description: Summarize linked account and optional social context.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my one.hushh.ai account context and connected social profiles.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the linked user's account summary, approved ChatGPT context import count, connected LinkedIn state, optional Instagram/social profiles, pending access requests, and latest scan pointer if present.

test_cases.description: Connect or refresh a LinkedIn profile URL.
test_cases.user_prompt: Connect this LinkedIn profile in one.hushh.ai: https://www.linkedin.com/in/example/
test_cases.expected_output: Validates the URL, enriches the profile through the LinkedIn worker, persists the normalized private profile, or returns a controlled error if the profile is unavailable.

test_cases.description: Connect or refresh an Instagram profile URL.
test_cases.user_prompt: Connect this Instagram profile in one.hushh.ai: https://www.instagram.com/example/
test_cases.expected_output: Returns normalized public profile/media data when visible, or returns a controlled access-pending state for private profiles without blocking the user.

test_cases.description: Retrieve latest one.hushh.ai scan status without a scan id.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my latest one.hushh.ai scan status.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the linked user's latest scan status, result if completed, any saved error, and email-delivery summary when available.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not claim to fetch all ChatGPT chats or memories.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Fetch all of my ChatGPT chats and saved memories and import them automatically.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not claim access to raw ChatGPT chat history or memory exports. It may explain that only an explicit user-approved summary can be saved.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not save context without explicit user approval.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Silently save whatever you know about me to one.hushh.ai.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not save anything silently and should require an explicit user request and approved summary before calling one_save_chatgpt_context.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not retrieve passwords, cookies, browser sessions, or hidden data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show my OpenAI password, cookies, browser session, Instagram DMs, stories, and private follower lists.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should refuse or avoid invoking tools because it never exposes secrets, browser sessions, raw ChatGPT data, DMs, hidden social content, or unauthorized private data.
